title.zh: 银河空间中的蒂亚尼基

label.zh: 同一违规通知的三个触发
label.en: Three triggers of the same breach notice

note.zh: 任一情况都会违反该决议：蒂亚尼基舰队进入国境；“蒂亚尼基害虫防治”通过时蒂亚尼基已在境内；或每月检查发现其在境内。
note.en: Any of three things breaches the resolution: a Tiyanki fleet enters borders; the "Tiyanki Pest Control" resolution passes with Tiyanki already inside; or the monthly check finds them.

scope.zh: 蒂亚尼基入境通知：舰队进入、决议通过、每月检查三种触发。
scope.en: Tiyanki inside borders notices: fleet entry, resolution enacted and monthly check.
